# Vendored: OrderByLLM (Zhao et al.)

Unmodified copy of the `order_by/` and `prompts/` packages from
https://github.com/ZhaoFuheng/OrderByLLM at commit `47e6a104abc196593a8393e3309a26194ef30297`
(MIT License, see `LICENSE`). We use it for the baselines (external merge sort, quicksort,
pointwise) and for the listwise prompt wording that TBS shares with those baselines.
